description: Eesti koondise mängijate klubide 2026-27 hooaja mängugraafikud. Kuupäevad ISO (kohalik aeg), time_local null = kellaaeg veel avaldamata.

competitions.name: BBL
competitions.notes: All 34 easyCredit BBL main-round games published with dates and times; matchday (Spieltag) numbers not shown on the club schedule page.

competitions.name: EuroCup
competitions.notes: All 14 BKT EuroCup regular season games (double round-robin vs 7 group opponents) published with dates and times; round numbers not shown on the club schedule page. Rounds listed here in chronological order.

competitions.name: BBL-Pokal
competitions.notes: Only the first-round cup tie is published; further rounds depend on advancement.

competitions.name: PLK (Orlen Basket Liga)
competitions.notes: 2026-27 Orlen Basket Liga regular season, 30 rounds (2026-10-02 to 2027-05-06). Rounds with time_local=null have published dates but tip-off times not yet set. Round 13 is scheduled before Round 12 (mid-week 2026-12-23). Full club name: PGE Start Lublin. No 2026 Superpuchar (participants: Legia, Trefl Sopot, Dziki, Zastal) and no 2026-27 European competition found for this club (not in BCL, FIBA Europe Cup or ENBL entry lists).

competitions.name: PLK (Orlen Basket Liga)
competitions.notes: Full 30-round 2026-27 regular season from official PLK schedule. Times published only for early rounds (1-6) and the synchronized final round 30 (all 06.05.2027 19:00); remaining tip-off times not yet set (null). Round 24 venue (away at Energa Trefl Sopot) confirmed via the schedule's mirror structure and two independent extractions. Playoffs (from 13.05.2027) not included as pairings depend on standings.

competitions.name: Basketball Champions League
competitions.notes: BCL 2026-27 regular season Group B (Galatasaray, SIG Strasbourg, Cibona Zagreb); all 6 group-stage dates published and confirmed by two sources. Times for Legia home games listed as TBD by legia.net (null here); away-game times consistent across sources. Play-in/knockout rounds from January 2027 depend on group results and are not included.

competitions.name: PLK (Orlen Basket Liga)
competitions.notes: Plays as Górnik Zamek Książ Wałbrzych. Full 30-round 2026-27 regular season from official PLK schedule. Times published only for rounds 1-4 and the synchronized final round 30 (06.05.2027 19:00); remaining tip-off times not yet set (null). Playoffs/play-in (from May 2027) not included as pairings depend on standings.

competitions.name: Serie A (LBA)
competitions.notes: Full 30-round asymmetric LBA calendar published 3 Aug 2026; exact tip-off times confirmed only for rounds 1-5, later rounds' dates are the published calendar dates and may still be moved. No league games between rounds 20 and 21 (Coppa Italia Final Eight, 17-21 Feb 2027 in Turin).

competitions.name: Supercoppa LBA 2026
competitions.notes: Final Four hosted by Tortona at the Nova Arena, 19-20 Sep 2026. Derthona plays the first semifinal; if it wins, the final is Sun 20 Sep 2026 at 17:00 vs the winner of Olimpia Milano - Virtus Bologna (final opponent not yet determined, so only the semifinal is listed as a fixture).

competitions.name: Serie A2
competitions.notes: Full 38-round Serie A2 Old Wild West calendar (20-team single group). Dates and times taken from the official club calendar (dinamobasket.com); times shown only where the club lists a confirmed tip-off (roughly through round 20), null elsewhere. Rounds 4 (17 Oct) and 14 (12 Dec) are Saturday anticipations per the club site, while some media list the default Sunday dates (18 Oct / 13 Dec). Sassari does not play the Supercoppa LNP 2026.

competitions.name: Serie A2
competitions.notes: Full 38-round Serie A2 Old Wild West calendar. Round-by-round list transcribed from sportal.it's complete league calendar; home/away cross-verified for 10 of 19 opponents against club sources (victorialibertas.it, centropagina.it, newsrimini.it, dinamobasket.com, tuttoudinese.it, newbasketbrindisi.it). Tip-off times not yet confirmed by the club, so left null. Round 24 vs Sassari: sportal.it lists Sat 30 Jan, Sassari's official site the default Sun 31 Jan - 31 Jan used here.

competitions.name: Supercoppa LNP 2026
competitions.notes: Supercoppa LNP Final Four at a neutral venue in Ravenna, 18-20 Sep 2026. Pesaro plays the semifinal vs Dole Rimini on Fri 18 Sep (tip-off time not yet published); the final is Sun 20 Sep vs the winner of Cividale - Fortitudo Bologna if Pesaro advances (not listed as a fixture).

competitions.name: Liga ACB
competitions.notes: All 34 jornadas from the official acb.com 2026-27 calendar. acb.com still shows tip-off times as placeholders (XX:XX) for every round; the dates given are the specific day each game is listed under on acb.com. Times for J1 (27.09 17:00 at Girona), J2 (04.10 19:00 vs Barca) and J20 (31.01 19:00 vs Real Madrid) come from the club's calendar announcement (ucamdeportes.com/la7tv); all other times unset.

competitions.name: Basketball Champions League (grupifaas, grupp G)
competitions.notes: All 6 published Group G (UCAM Murcia, Openjobmetis Varese, Brose Bamberg, Peristeri) group-stage games; dates match the official BCL gameday windows. Fixture dates/times transcribed from basketnews.com (times may not be arena-local; official BCL site does not expose times in static form). Round = gameday number inferred from chronological order. Knockout rounds (Play-ins/Round of 16 onwards, Jan-May 2027) depend on group results and have no fixtures yet.

competitions.name: Primera FEB
competitions.notes: All 34 jornadas (18-team league, 25.09.2026-07.05.2027). Jornadas 1-15 incl. dates and times transcribed from the official FEB live calendar (baloncestoenvivo.feb.es); J14 at Menorca shows a 0:00 placeholder time there, so time left unset. Jornadas 16-34 dates from RealGM/Proballers (same FEB feed), with jornada numbers and key dates (J16 12.01, J24 09.03, J34 07.05, midweek rounds) corroborated by Alimerka Oviedo's calendar article; times for J16-34 not yet published. Midweek jornadas: J16 (Tue 12.01), J20 (Tue 09.02), J24 (Tue 09.03), J31 (Tue 20.04). movistarestudiantes.com calendar page was unreachable from this environment.

competitions.name: Betclic Elite
competitions.notes: All 30 journees of the 16-team 2026-27 Betclic Elite regular season (opener J1 Dijon-Strasbourg Fri 25.09.2026, confirmed by BeBasket). Journee numbers, dates and the times shown for J1-J14 transcribed from BeBasket's Dijon calendar page; J15-J30 times not yet published. Where BeBasket and Proballers dates differed by one day within the same weekend (J3, J4, J5), the BeBasket date (with confirmed time) was used. lnb.fr and jdadijon.com were unreachable from this environment (403/503). Proballers additionally lists Aug/early-Sep 2026 preseason friendlies (Vichy, Roanne, Chalon, Nancy) - excluded as non-league games.

competitions.name: Eesti-Läti liiga
competitions.notes: All 22 league games published on the club schedule page as of 2026-09-07 (verified twice). Away fixtures in Latvia vs BK Ventspils, Rigas Ekselences Juniori, Rigas Zelli, BK Liepaja, VEF Riga and Latvijas Universitate are not yet listed on the page, so the full double round-robin is not yet published there. Home venue mostly Nord Spordihoone, Tallinn.

competitions.name: FIBA Europe Cup
competitions.notes: 9 group-stage games published; the home game vs Manchester Basketball is not listed on the page yet. Group opponents: Glint Manisa Basket, Valmiera Glass VIA, BC Baskhimi, Manchester Basketball, Elan Chalon.

competitions.name: Eesti-Läti liiga
competitions.notes: Club calendar page (basket.ut.ee/kalender-26-27) had only September and October 2026 populated as of 2026-09-07; November-May sections were empty. The 2027-01-09 away game vs Bigbank/Kalev is transcribed from the opponent's published schedule (bckalev.ee/ajakava). Remaining fixtures live on basket.ut.ee/kalender-26-27 once published, and on estlatbl.com (robots-blocked for automated fetching).

competitions.name: FIBA Europe Cup
competitions.notes: Only the four October 2026 group games were published on the club calendar; later group rounds (November onward) not yet listed.

competitions.notes: Only three fixtures could be transcribed, all from opponents' published schedules (Tartu Ülikool and Bigbank/Kalev club pages). The club site taltechbasketball.ee loads its game calendar dynamically and exposed no fixture rows; its schedule link points to https://www.estlatbl.com/en/results?tid=9033 (robots-blocked). Full fixture list lives on estlatbl.com.

competitions.name: ENBL
competitions.notes: Club homepage shows an upcoming ENBL home game vs Fyllingen Lions but without an extractable date/time; the ENBL schedule page (enbleague.eu/schedule) is JavaScript-rendered and returned no fixture data. No dated ENBL fixtures could be transcribed.

competitions.name: NBA
competitions.notes: 2026-27 regular season schedule released 2026-08-13. 80 of 82 games have fixed dates; the remaining 2 games (for teams not reaching the NBA Cup knockout rounds) will be slotted into the open mid-December window (Dec 4-11) after NBA Cup group play resolves, so both sources list 80 dated games. All times are US Eastern (local for home games shown as listed by Basketball-Reference).

competitions.name: NCAA Division I (Southland Conference)
competitions.notes: Full 2026-27 schedule as posted: 33 entries = 1 exhibition (Oct 23 vs Sam Houston) + 32 games, of which 2 Paradise Jam games have bracket-dependent TBD opponents (31 games with known opponents). Times are local Central time as listed (Paradise Jam games local USVI/listed time); null = TBA. Home games at Johnson Coliseum, Nacogdoches, Texas; Paradise Jam games (Nov 20-23) are neutral site in Charlotte Amalie, St. Thomas, USVI.

competitions.name: LKL
competitions.notes: Kõik 36 põhiturniiri mängu (10 meeskonda, 4 ringi; hooaeg 2026-09-17 kuni 2027-05-16). Iga vastasega 2 kodu- ja 2 võõrsilmängu — kontrollitud. Ajad on Leedu kohalikud (basketnews.lt); lkl.lt näitas avamänguks 16:30, basketnews 16:50 — ajad võivad TV-graafiku tõttu nihkuda. Play-off algab 2027-05-19.

competitions.name: BKT EuroCup (C-grupp)
competitions.notes: Neptūnas mängib 2026-27 BKT EuroCupi C-grupis (32 meeskonda, 4 gruppi 8-ga, 14 mängu). Kellaajad on Leedu aja järgi (ka võõrsilmängudel). Basketnews näitas ka 2026-09-12 mängu Sabah Bakuu vastu 'Eurocupi' sildiga, kuid Sabah ei ole ametlikus 32 meeskonna loosis — tõenäoliselt kontrollmäng, välja jäetud.

competitions.name: B.LEAGUE PREMIER
competitions.notes: RealGM-i tabelis on 59 mängu (2026-09-26 kuni 2027-05-01, Jaapani kohalikud kuupäevad); liiga on teatanud 60-mängulisest hooajast, seega üks mäng võib loendist puududa (b-corsairs.com ametlik graafik on JS/PDF-põhine ega olnud loetav). Kellaajad RealGM-is olid vaid USA aja teisendused — jäetud tühjaks.

competitions.name: Liga Națională
competitions.notes: U-BT Cluj jätab koduse Rumeenia liiga põhihooaja vahele ja liitub alles play-off'is — põhiturniiri mänge klubil ei ole, seetõttu graafik puudub.

competitions.name: BKT EuroCup (B-grupp)
competitions.notes: 2026-27 EuroCupi formaat on 4 gruppi 8 meeskonnaga ehk 14 põhiturniiri mängu (mitte 18). Kellaajad pole veel avaldatud. Šiauliai kodumäng (2026-12-16) toimub tõenäoliselt Turdas, kuna BT Arena on hõivatud käsipalli EM-iga.

competitions.name: ABA League (esimene faas)
competitions.notes: Esimese faasi 18 vooru; kaks sõltumatut allikat andsid identse kalendri. NB! 11. voor (SC Derby kodus) on tõstetud 2027-01-21 peale, seetõttu pole kuupäevad vooru numbri järgi kronoloogilised. Kellaajad pole veel avaldatud. Top 8 faas algab 2027-02-06.
